page.overview:
Who is Luke?

Luke is a character appearing in the Pokémon the Series: Black & White.

Luke has light brown hair and blue eyes. He wears rounded glasses and is dressed in light brown pants with a collared shirt that is light brown and green, along with suspenders.

Luke is an aspiring young filmmaker who is passionate about movies.

Luke was into movies, so he decided to make some on his own. He encountered a Zorua in the theatre one day, who promised to accompany him to make movies.
